absent.note: Murata's specification tabulates no DC-bias capacitance change; its Rating cautions only warn that a class-II capacitor's capacitance falls with applied DC voltage. For this part Murata's product data flags separately downloadable characteristic data files (isECD, isSparameter and isNetList true; isBasicCharacteristicGraph and isFrequencyCharacteristicGraph false). Those files are not the specification and are not cited here, and the capacitor profile takes a DC-bias change only from a vendor table, so no figure is recorded.

Murata's specification has no absolute-maximum table. Its Rating cautions bound the voltage between the terminations, surges and pulses included, by the rated voltage, which the record carries as ratings.recommended.voltage_rating; the voltage-proof test level is a production test, not a rating, and the storage conditions are for unmounted parts' solderability, not a storage-temperature limit.

description: 22 uF +/-20% 10 V X5R MLCC, EIA 0805 (2012M), -55 to 85 C, Murata GRM series, 180 mm embossed reel
notes:
Benchmark (c) uses this part as 3V3 bulk capacitance (/c4, /c6, /c19). Its source spells the family, GRM21BR61A226ME44, without Murata's packaging code; the pick helper maps it to this record by the murata-packaging-code rule, and L (180 mm embossed reel) is a proposed choice for L5b to confirm.

Murata tabulates no DC-bias capacitance change (only separately downloadable characteristic data, not cited here), which matters for a 10 V class-II part on a 3.3 V rail. Murata publishes no absolute-maximum table: the rated voltage, which Murata says must also bound surges and pulses, is ratings.recommended.voltage_rating.

pins.description: End termination 1. No polarity is marked; the two terminations are interchangeable.

provenance.note: Record default. The cited source is Murata's per-part specification (reference sheet) for this part-number family; it covers every packaging code, and the packaging letter in /mpn selects one reel. Every value here is read from it unless a deeper entry says otherwise. Pin naming and roles are the record's convention (see /pins).

/lifecycle.locator: productionStatus field of the part's product data, shown on the pim.murata.com product details page
/lifecycle.note: Murata lists the production status as In Production (the productionStatus value available); active is the lifecycle vocabulary's word for it, a mapping rather than Murata's own word. The source is the JSON the product details page renders, fetched by POST to the cited URL with body {"searchCondClass":2,"partNum":"GRM21BR61A226ME44#","page":1,"pageSize":20,"productCategoryId":"ceramicCapacitorSMD","languageRegion":"en-us","series":"","sortKey":"","valSearchCondList":[],"rangeValSearchCondList":[],"dateRangeSearchCondList":[]}; the details page itself is a script shell whose bytes carry no product data.

/mpn.locator: page 2, MURATA Part No. System; page 2, Package table (packaging code L)
/mpn.note: The specification is titled for the family GRM21BR61A226ME44_, the trailing character standing for the packaging code. The record is the orderable member with code L (180 mm reel, plastic tape W8P4, 3000 pcs), a code the Package table lists; Murata's product data for GRM21BR61A226ME44# (source murata-pim-grm21br61a226me44-2026-10-24) lists GRM21BR61A226ME44L among its orderable part numbers.

/package.note: Murata prints the size code as 2012M(0805); the record's package name is the EIA inch code, 0805, and the two terminations are the pin count.

/parameters/capacitance.locator: page 2, Rated Value table, Capacitance and Capacitance Tolerance columns; page 3, Specifications and Test Methods item 6 (Capacitance)
/parameters/capacitance.note: The nominal 22 uF is the Capacitance column (and the part number's 226 code). min and max are that nominal at the +/-20 % tolerance, arithmetic on stated values, so datasheet-derived. The conditions are the measurement conditions of the Capacitance test item: room temperature, 120 +/-24 Hz (written as its range, 96 to 144 Hz), 0.5 +/-0.1 Vrms.

/parameters/capacitance_tolerance.locator: page 2, Rated Value table, Capacitance Tolerance column
/parameters/capacitance_tolerance.note: +/-20% written as a fraction of nominal.

/parameters/temperature_characteristic.locator: page 2, Rated Value table, Temp. coeff. or Cap. Change, Temp. Range and Ref.Temp. columns; page 3, Specifications and Test Methods item 8 (Temperature Characteristics of Capacitance)
/parameters/temperature_characteristic.note: X5R: capacitance change within -15 to +15 % over -55 to 85 degC about the 25 degC reference, measured with no DC bias (written vdc 0 V) and under 1.0 Vrms.

/pins.note: Murata publishes no pin table for a chip capacitor. Its Type & Dimension drawing shows two identical end terminations with no polarity mark, so the record names them 1 and 2 and gives both role passive, as the authoring convention does for every two-terminal passive. The numbering is the record's, not Murata's.

/ratings/recommended/ambient_temperature.locator: page 2, Rated Value table, Operating Temp. Range column; page 12, Rating section 4 (Type of Applied Voltage and Self-heating Temperature)
/ratings/recommended/ambient_temperature.note: Murata's operating temperature range. Its Rating cautions hold the capacitor's own surface temperature, self-heating included, inside this range, so as a bound on ambient it is optimistic by whatever self-heating the circuit causes.

/ratings/recommended/voltage_rating.locator: page 2, Rated Value table, Rated Voltage column; page 3, Specifications and Test Methods item 1 (Rated Voltage); page 11, Rating section 3 (Applied Voltage)
/ratings/recommended/voltage_rating.note: DC 10 V. Murata defines the rated voltage as the most that may be applied continuously; with AC superimposed the larger of the peak-to-peak and zero-to-peak voltages must stay within it, and the Rating cautions extend the bound to surges, static and pulses. Recorded as max: it is the vendor's limit for the design.
